_doc: Input-to-photon budgets in MILLISECONDS. See LATENCY_HARNESS.md. Continuous interactions (drag/hover/scroll/window-move) are ONE FRAME by construction: exceeding 16ms means an easing layer sits between the input and the transform, which is the exact model error behind the 2026-07-20 rubber-band drag. A budget may only be RAISED with a justification recorded in the same commit.

orb._note: The centerpiece. Drag/hover are the interactions the steward personally hit as laggy; they are the program's headline number.

bloom-field._note: Never input-driven; measured for animate-start + sustained frame time only.

onboarding._note: First thing a user ever sees; carries the full desktop bar.
